question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessions.diagnose` and `openclaw sessions diagnose` as a durable read-only operator diagnosis contract now?
rationale: The code path is bounded and tested, but the PR creates a new public Gateway/CLI/protocol vocabulary that automated review cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Accept the contract
options.body: Merge the read-only diagnosis surface and treat its outcome, state, and finding vocabulary as the current operator API.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the author to trim or rename result fields, finding codes, or CLI behavior before the protocol becomes durable.

options.title: Defer the API
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want diagnosis folded into existing status/session surfaces or broader stuck-session work first.

recommendation.title: Accept the contract
recommendation.body: Merge the read-only diagnosis surface and treat its outcome, state, and finding vocabulary as the current operator API.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session Gateway/protocol/client work makes this the closest product/API ownership signal in the reviewed history.
